title: Pher Na Hwey
desc: Javed Akhtar interprets Vrind's doha "Pher Na Hwey" where he speaks about trust, faith, relationship, love, lies & how all these aspects impact our relationships.

title: Roz Mitiye Kaise
desc: Javed Akhtar interprets Vrind's doha "Roz Mitiye Kaise" where he says in relationships there shouldn't be any ego and people should try to control their anger for the betterment of their relationships.

title: Subodh Beech Pari
desc: Javed Akhtar interprets Vrind's doha "Subodh Beech Pari" where he elaborates on family bonds. He says when an understanding person tries to resolve a fight, he always aims at creating a win-win situation.

title: Ek Saadhey Sab
desc: Javed Akhtar interprets Rahim's doha "Ek Saadhey Sab" where he says, we must focus on one task at a time; if one tries to work on multiple tasks at the same time, none of the tasks will be accomplished.

title: Kariye Sukh
desc: Javed Akhtar interprets Vrind's doha "Kariye Sukh" where he says, people can't be truly happy if they make others sad. One must take care to ensure that one's happiness does not cause sadness to others.

title: Uttam Jan So
desc: Javed Akhtar interprets Vrind's doha "Uttam Jan So" where he says, just as the saline sea leaves its saltiness and becomes sweet on meeting the clouds, one should always keep the company of good people.
